Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [page/1/Text/3] Interests involve the extent to which people like particular school or work activities, and satisfaction is defined as one's enjoyment of the educational or occupational environment in which these activities occur. Personality traits, or affective tendencies, such as positive affectivity (the general tendency to experience positive affect), represent dispositions that contribute to the experience of domain-specific satisfaction (Lent & Brown, 2006).
